purpose: genrule(executable = True) (rules/genrule/GenRuleBase.java:78-86, 215-235, 288-298): the single output is the target's executable (FilesToRunProvider without runfiles support) for dep[DefaultInfo].files_to_run, ctx.executable, genrule tools, $(location)/$(execpath)/$(rootpath), Starlark run_shell tools and `bazel run` (Rule.isExecutable, RunCommand.java:1191-1207); several outputs are an attribute error (reported with the missing-cmd error). Motivation: build_stack_rules_proto's //toolchain:protoc_exe (an executable genrule copying a select()ed prebuilt protoc) blocked analysis of ~/code's //src/beyondwork.ai/tools/....

reference.environment: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME/TMPDIR private LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8; default registry (bcr.bazel.build); one fresh copy of the fixture workspace per case (platforms extracted from tests/fixtures/label_repo_name/platforms_archive.json)

normalization: <WS> = the case's workspace copy; <OB> = the genuine output base; <CACHE> = the native cache; elapsed times <T>. Outputs are the top-level outputs (genuine --show_result lines, bazel-bin = bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin; native LABEL<TAB>PATH lines below the action output root) as [mode, contents].
comparison (tests/genrule_executable.rs,: MATCH: success equal; WARNING lines equal in order; Bazel's first ERROR message ends a native stderr line; built top-level outputs (path below bazel-out -> [mode, contents]) equal; `run` stdout (the program's output) equal. DECLARED_DIVERGENCE: native fails with the recorded message.
genuine_key_findings: An executable genrule's single output is files_to_run.executable (also through ctx.executable and run_shell tools, in the exec configuration as a genrule tool); a non-executable genrule has none (`None`).

`bazel run` of an executable genrule runs its output without a runfiles tree (`INFO: Running command line: bazel-bin/pkg/exe.sh <args omitted>`); a non-executable genrule is `Cannot run target //pkg:plain: Not executable` (exit 2).

Several outputs: `in executable attribute of genrule rule //pkg:two: if genrules produce executables, they are allowed only one output. If you need the executable=1 argument, then you should split this genrule into genrules producing single outputs`, followed by the missing-cmd attribute error when `cmd` is missing too.
Outputs are 0555 on both sides (unchanged by executable = True).

In an attr.label(allow_single_file = True, executable = True, cfg = 'exec') attribute (build_stack_rules_proto's protoc toolchain rule, `tool = ":protoc.exe"`), ctx.executable.tool and ctx.file.tool are the same file for an executable genrule's output file, for the genrule itself, and for a non-executable genrule's output file (every file target's FilesToRunProvider is its artifact, FileConfiguredTarget.createFilesToRunProvider).
known_divergences: Exit codes of command-line errors: genuine 2, native 1 (native's single error channel); success/failure always agrees.
Native prints its own result format (`LABEL\tPATH`, `bazel-rs: N actions executed ...`) and no INFO lines; `run` reports the native output path of the executable.
Declared divergence probe_plain_tool (pre-existing): see the case.
Native needs --experimental-builtin-modules for the exec cases (the default host platform's @platforms//host); it is passed in every native case.
